d:
I was in Chail, Himachal Pradesh for a show and while coming back my team and I found this beautiful place. We loved it so much that we decided to record a live, raw version of my song "Gul" here. We set up a mic, a few cameras, made DIY shoe covers, battled a bunch of spiders and hoped for the best. So here's this one take recording of the song, enjoy. x
Shot by : Neofox Media [IG : neofoxmedia]
I'm finally going on TOUR and I'm coming to JAI, BLR, HYD, LKO, DEL, IXC. Would love to see all of you there and perform for you. Get your tickets to my upcoming tour "Dastakein" here :
